recommended_tweet_angles: ETF flows = price discovery algorithm now: $500M+ weekly inflows = 5-15% gains; $200M+ outflows = 5-20% declines. Traditional finance didn't join Bitcoin; Bitcoin joined TradFi's order flow. The chain is transparent. Their flows aren't.

Strive accumulating 2,500 BTC at $74.1k avg while retail margin liquidates at $67.2k. Asymmetric conviction. This is how capital reorganizes during fear regimes. Institutions know the playbook — accumulation phases precede narrative shifts.

Regulatory codification incoming: Crypto Clarity Act marketed as consumer protection. Read the mechanics: stablecoin containment + CBDC infrastructure pre-positioning + programmable money guardrails. Not regulation. Financial architecture restructuring.

Oslo Freedom Forum 2026: Bitcoin positioned as stateless infrastructure for activists, journalists, persecuted populations. Not asset speculation. Not banking. Human rights technology. This narrative trajectory matters more than $5.8% 24h volatility.

Bear market truth: Most Bitcoin conflict is temporal scarcity anxiety, not protocol disagreement. Lopp nails it—folks want scapegoats for disappointing TradFi returns. Network fundamentals (security, hashrate, adoption) unchanged. Emotion is signal distortion.
